cli.inputs.reason.corrupt: the archive is damaged, or laid out in a way the kit does not read (several disks, an entry twice)
cli.inputs.reason.encrypted: it is encrypted or protected by a password
cli.inputs.reason.method: an entry is compressed with another method than deflate
cli.inputs.reason.missingPart: the archive holds no word/document.xml: it is not a Word document
cli.inputs.reason.notPdf: not a PDF file (it does not start with %PDF-)
cli.inputs.reason.notZip: not a ZIP archive (a .docx is one; a Word file protected by a password is not)
cli.inputs.reason.ratio: an entry is far bigger once uncompressed than in the archive (a ZIP bomb?)
cli.inputs.reason.tooLarge: too large for the kit's limits
cli.inputs.reason.tooManyEntries: the archive holds too many entries
cli.inputs.reason.xml: its XML is malformed, too deep or too large
cli.inputs.reason.zip64: a ZIP64 archive (over 4 GB or 65,535 entries), which the kit does not read
